score.note: The first compiling m2c draft was 1628 bytes with 846 differing halfwords, but omitted both outputs of Func_080cef64 and represented the 20-step coordinate history as out-of-bounds scalar arithmetic. Reconstructing DrawRectangleFn callbacks[2], the retained callback pointer, position[3], and history[40] restores the reference's exact 228-byte stack frame and models every call_via_r4 site as an ordinary six-argument indirect draw. The larger 1804-byte candidate is retained because it fixes real call semantics and memory safety; aggregate score is diagnostic, not the acceptance contract. The remaining mismatch spans the owner and is honestly classified structural-topology, not an allocation floor.

family.template_note: This is another 0x03001eec battle-work presentation owner, but its behavior is distinct: it precomputes two opposing particle streams, draws a table-driven centre animation, shifts a 20-position trail, and advances two particle groups over 150 frames. The shared family contributes the heap-cache cursor, Func_080cef64 callback pair, work offsets, and teardown contract; it does not justify copying member_orbit's source shape.

rejected_experiments: Keeping m2c's four-argument Func_080072f4 calls compiled, but treated the r4 call-via veneer as a real function and discarded the width and height stored immediately before every retained call. Rejected in favor of typed DrawRectangleFn calls.

Keeping scalar sp38/sp44 locals reproduced m2c's unsafe out-of-bounds pointer arithmetic and a 44-byte frame instead of the retained 228-byte frame. Rejected in favor of explicit position and history arrays.
notes: Recovered from games/gs1/asm/080e89ec.s, the approved local ROM-derived tables at 0x080ede48/9f/a5/ab/b2, the m2c structural draft generated by the repository compiler, and already-recorded 0x03001eec family evidence in 080e01e4.c/json and 080ed104.c. The temporary source name BattleEffect_RunDualParticleStream describes only behavior visible in the retained owner. Callback-table entry 49 and resources_d1_d3_idou_d3.json establish battle-effect ownership, but do not establish an English move name, so none is invented.

Func_080cef64 writes two DrawRectangleFn values at stack offsets 48 and 52. Retained Func_080072f4 branches load r4 from one of those slots and are the r4 member of the call_via_rN veneer bundle, so the C calls callbacks[0] or callbacks[1] directly with destination, source, x, y, width, and height.
This measured draft claims zero DONE bytes and leaves the canonical assembly owner in place.
